scope: Pre-Gate 4 immediate repairs and consent-aware SMS; local macOS arm64 offline verification plus separately identified live setup

immediate_repairs.R03: Actual reference UI continuation, receipt visibility, voice preflight and stable mutation IDs across reload

gate3.note: Broad run precedes two narrow final fixes: Telnyx retry metadata deduplication and first-attempt UI rejection recovery. Both received targeted follow-up tests.

targeted_followup.real_chromium: passed: message 101, lost ACK/reload/replay exactly once, voice rejection before microphone, no page errors

live.campaign_and_number: Approved; all carrier mappings ADDED; exact approved HELP/STOP/START response text verified
live.recipient_form: Original affirmative enrollment reviewed via admin session + CSRF; installation/conversation/sender-bound 24-hour grant synchronized.
live.rudeless_deployment: Succeeded; backend only, PostgreSQL container preserved, original consent fingerprint unchanged. Off-host backup restored in disposable local PostgreSQL.
live.connect_migration: Schema 9 to 10 with verified backup; existing identities, credentials, conversations, messages and routes unchanged before SMS route addition.
live.sms_delivery: Passed: initial HTTP SDK send, five handset/Vapi conversation turns, native UCTP/QUIC recall of prior SMS context, and fresh post-START SDK delivery with signed callback.
live.callback_boundary: Qualified release uses its built-in webhook-only listener; custom proxy removed. Public application API returns 404; unsigned webhook returns 401.
live.voice_route: Original Telnyx voice connection read back unchanged after SMS configuration.
live.sms_controls: Passed: real HELP/STOP/START callbacks, no keyword assistant prompts, native SDK send cancelled as opted-out before provider submission, same-ID replay preserved, subsequent START allowed a new delivered message while the old cancelled request remained cancelled.

private_evidence: Raw logs, credentials, handset details, database snapshots and provider identifiers remain ignored under .local; original audit reproductions are historical at a20de33.
unresolved: R05–R08 qualification and Gate 4 design work remain as scoped in the original review.
